measurement: 120 fresh solves per population per version, cold geometric and optical state, warm code and allocations. Chrome GPU completion plus matching compositor frame swap markers. Physical scanout and full process/driver memory unmeasured. The camera worker overlaps transport. Populations 1, 2 and 0 correspond to one slat, two slats and the crowded moving replay.
workCountsOrder: individual receiver using common lamp field
shadowAuditMethod: Outward-relaxed necessary bounds for the eye cone on each authored planar sheet. At tick 30 sample 175 additional rejected pairs per population which passed the previous tile/half-space screen. Clip the finite tile against the exact five half-spaces of each sheet or the six faces of the outer box enclosing the actual filleted solid, using rationals. A coplanar eye and sheet have zero projected solid angle. Check positive area, not measure-zero contact.
weakEquilibriumNotes: Changed the two reciprocal transfer blocks and re-solved the entire current room. Comparisons use the same first-bounce right hand side. The floor/bench replacement uses positive lumped area projection. Because the remaining blocks use point observations, the combined room fails the unit hemisphere mass bound. These trials are offline; zero frame savings claimed for the weak blocks.

geometryMassAtMinus46.scope: production weights measured before adding sheet bounds; all sampled final-segment and full-path RGB in sourceAttribution were rerun with the published kernels

qualityNotes: Channel comparisons include direct, reflected and total 4K from the same fresh scene. The same pose and camera are revisited after two edits. Across-scene physical accuracy is not inferred from revision equality. The reported memory is counted payload, excluding uninstrumented JS and browser/OS/device overhead. The mean-only refinements used the packed-basis comparator. Four-moment and source-attribution probes use the playable kernels.
shortComparisonNotes: 12 poses each. outline clipped full polygons for bounds only and was not selected. Packed, outline and project denote sparse modal transform, direct outline clip and coordinate elimination respectively. Production still draws no polygonal geometry.
